    The path-length grading of a scalar mesh category #

    graded-category.tex: "The quotient is graded by path length." The mesh relations are homogeneous, so the degree projections of kQ descend to C(Q, c) and its degree parts are independent (iSupIndep_degreePart). If C(Q, c) is finite-dimensional, only finitely many degree parts are nonzero, so all sufficiently long paths vanish (exists_pathMor_eq_zero); this is the first step of the proof of Proposition 4.1 (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex).
